aulas.objetivo: Entender nomes, sobrenomes e idades ditos em uma conversa curta e anotar as letras.
aulas.foco: Verb to be; alphabet; numbers 1–15; How old are you?
explicacao: Na prova, nomes costumam ser soletrados letra por letra: Z-O-E. Treine o alfabeto em inglês.
Para a idade: I'm nine. / He is eleven. Em inglês usamos to be, não have.
Cuidado com o som final: thirteen (treze) e thirty (trinta) são diferentes.

falas.t: Hello! What's your name?
My name is Zoe.
How do you spell that?
Z-O-E. Zoe Parker.
Nice to meet you, Zoe. How old are you?
I'm nine. My brother is eleven. His name is Jack.
Is Jack in this school?
Yes, he is. He's in Class six.
Welcome to our school, Zoe!

exercicios.q: How old is Zoe?
exercicios.exp: Zoe diz: I'm nine. Eleven é a idade do irmão e six é a turma dele.

exercicios.q: Her surname is ___.
exercicios.exp: Ela soletra: Z-O-E. Zoe Parker. O sobrenome é Parker.
exercicios.ouvir: Z-O-E. Zoe Parker.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Nice to meet you. My name is Zoe.
exercicios.exp: Meet: /mit/, som longo. Zoe: /ZÔ-i/.

exercicios.q: Who is in Class six?
exercicios.exp: Jack: He's in Class six. Zoe não tem irmã na conversa.

exercicios.resp: How do you spell your name
exercicios.exp: Pergunta com How + do you + verbo: How do you spell...?

exercicios.q: Zoe's brother is ___ years old.
exercicios.exp: My brother is eleven. Não confunda com nine, a idade da Zoe.
exercicios.ouvir: I'm nine. My brother is eleven.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: diga seu nome e soletre.
exercicios.frase: What's your name and how do you spell it?
exercicios.exp: Diga My name is... e soletre as letras do seu nome.

exercicios.q: Listen. How do you spell her name?
exercicios.exp: No áudio vem a letra Y no final: Z-O-E-Y.
exercicios.ouvir: Her name is Zoey. Z-O-E-Y.

exercicios.q: Zoe is nine and her brother Jack is in Class ___.
exercicios.exp: Jack is in Class six. O número da turma não é a idade dele.
exercicios.ouvir: Zoe is nine years old and her brother Jack is in Class six.

aulas.objetivo: Entender números, preços e telefones ditos em voz alta, sem confundir -teen e -ty.
aulas.foco: Numbers 1–100; teen vs ty; phone numbers; How much?
explicacao: Diga os números de telefone um por um: 0 = zero (ou oh), 7 = seven. Dois números iguais: double five.
-teen tem a força no final (thir-TEEN); -ty tem a força no começo (THIR-ty). Ouça com atenção: 13 ou 30?
Preço: It's eighteen pounds. Em inglês britânico a moeda é pound (£).

falas.t: Good morning. Sunny Pool. Can I help you?
Hi. I want to join the swimming class. My name's Ben.
OK, Ben. What's your phone number?
It's zero seven three, one four eight, six two.
Zero seven three, one four eight, six two. And how old are you?
I'm thirteen.
The class is for twelve to fifteen year olds. It's on Tuesdays and the price is eighteen pounds.
Eighteen? Not eighty?
No, eighteen pounds.

exercicios.q: How old is Ben?
exercicios.exp: Ben diz I'm thirteen. Thirty seria muito mais velho; twelve e fifteen são só a idade da turma.

exercicios.q: The price is ___ pounds.
exercicios.exp: Eighteen (18), não eighty (80).
exercicios.ouvir: The price is eighteen pounds.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Is it thirteen or thirty?
exercicios.exp: Thirteen: força no final (thir-TEEN). Thirty: força no começo (THIR-ty).

exercicios.q: What is the price of the class?
exercicios.exp: Ela confirma: No, eighteen pounds. Eighty é a pegadinha da pergunta do Ben.
Pergunta: What is + your phone number?

exercicios.q: The last two numbers are ___.
exercicios.exp: Ben termina o número com six two.
exercicios.ouvir: Zero seven three, one four eight, six two.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: diga seu número de telefone (pode inventar).
exercicios.frase: What's your phone number?
exercicios.modelo: It's zero seven, one two three, four five six.
exercicios.exp: Diga os números um a um: It's zero seven...

exercicios.q: Listen. What are the two numbers?
exercicios.exp: House number fifteen (15) e telefone terminando em fifty (50).
exercicios.ouvir: My house is number fifteen, and my phone number ends in fifty.

exercicios.q: The lesson is on Tuesday at five ___.
exercicios.exp: No áudio: five fifty, ou seja, 5.50.
exercicios.ouvir: The lesson is on Tuesday at five fifty.

aulas.objetivo: Entender dias da semana, datas e horas (half past, quarter to) em conversas curtas.
aulas.foco: Days; months; ordinal numbers; telling the time
explicacao: Horas: o'clock (3:00), half past (3:30), quarter past (3:15), quarter to (2:45), ten past (3:10).
Datas: the fifth of June (5 de junho). Os ordinais: first, second, third, fourth, fifth...
Usamos on com dias (on Monday) e at com horas (at nine).

falas.t: Tom, what time is football practice on Saturday?
It's at half past nine, Mum.
Half past nine? Last week it was at quarter to ten.
Yes, but this week the coach is early. And my piano lesson is on Wednesday at ten past four.
OK. And Grandma's birthday?
It's on the fifth of June.
Great. Let's buy a present on Sunday afternoon.
Can we go at two o'clock?
Yes, at two.

exercicios.q: What time is football practice on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: Half past nine = 9.30. Quarter to ten (9.45) era o horário da semana passada.

exercicios.q: My piano lesson is on ___.
exercicios.exp: Piano lesson: Wednesday, às dez e dez (ten past four).
exercicios.ouvir: My piano lesson is on Wednesday.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Football practice is at half past nine.
exercicios.exp: Half: /hAf/, o l não se pronuncia.

exercicios.q: When is Grandma's birthday?
exercicios.exp: The fifth of June = 5 de junho.

exercicios.resp: My lesson is at ten past four
exercicios.exp: Ten past four = quatro e dez (4.10).

exercicios.q: They go shopping on ___ at two.
exercicios.exp: Let's buy a present on Sunday afternoon, às duas (two o'clock).
exercicios.ouvir: Let's go shopping on Sunday at two o'clock.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: que dia é hoje?
exercicios.frase: What day is it today?
exercicios.exp: Responda: Today is... ou It's...

exercicios.q: What time is the piano lesson?
exercicios.exp: Ten past four = 4.10. Ten to four seria 3.50.
exercicios.ouvir: My piano lesson is on Wednesday at ten past four.

exercicios.q: Last week football was at quarter ___ ten.
exercicios.exp: Quarter to ten = 9.45 (quinze para as dez).
exercicios.ouvir: Last week practice was at quarter to ten.

aulas.objetivo: Entender quem é quem numa família: parentescos, idades e o que cada um faz.
explicacao: Parentescos: mum, dad, brother, sister, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin.
O 's mostra posse: my dad's brother = o irmão do meu pai.
He é para menino e she para menina: He's a pilot. She likes dancing.

falas.t: Look, this is a photo of my family.
Who is the man with the beard?
That's my uncle Pete. He's my dad's brother. He's a pilot.
And the girl next to him?
That's my cousin, Lucy. She's ten. She likes dancing.
Is this your grandmother?
Yes, she's my mum's mum. She's seventy-two and she lives with us.
And who's the baby?
That's my little brother, Sam. He's one.
He's lovely!

exercicios.q: Who is Pete?
exercicios.exp: Pete é irmão do pai da Mia: my uncle Pete. He's my dad's brother.

exercicios.q: Pete is my dad's ___.
exercicios.exp: My uncle Pete. He's my dad's brother.
exercicios.ouvir: Pete is my dad's brother.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: She is my mum's mum and she lives with us.
exercicios.exp: Lives: /lIvz/ com i curto.

exercicios.q: What does Mia's cousin like?
exercicios.exp: Lucy likes dancing. Flying (voar) combina com o tio piloto, mas é pegadinha.

exercicios.resp: That is my little brother Sam
exercicios.exp: Ordem: That is + my + little + brother + nome.

exercicios.q: Mia's grandmother is ___ years old.
exercicios.exp: Seventy-two = 72. Não confunda com seventeen (17).
exercicios.ouvir: She's seventy-two and she lives with us.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: quem está na sua família?
exercicios.frase: Who is in your family?
exercicios.modelo: I've got a mum, a dad and a sister.
exercicios.exp: Use I've got... ou There are... in my family.

exercicios.q: How old is Sam?
exercicios.exp: He's one. Ten é a idade da Lucy e seventy-two é a da avó.

exercicios.q: Pete is a ___ and he is Mia's uncle.
exercicios.exp: No áudio: He's a pilot.
exercicios.ouvir: He is a pilot and he is my dad's brother.

aulas.objetivo: Entender uma rotina diária: horários, atividades e meios de transporte.
aulas.foco: Present simple (I/he/she); daily routine; times; by bus/train
explicacao: Present simple fala de rotina: I get up at six. She goes to school by train.
Com he/she/it o verbo ganha s: goes, plays, does (do → does, go → goes).
Horários: at six thirty, at seven fifteen. By + transporte: by bus, by train.

falas.t: Nina, what time do you get up?
I get up at six thirty because I live far from school.
Six thirty! Then what?
I have a shower and I have breakfast with my dad. We leave at seven fifteen.
Do you go by bus?
No, I go by train. School starts at eight forty-five.
And after school?
I do my homework, then I play tennis. I go to bed at nine.

exercicios.q: What time does Nina get up?
exercicios.exp: I get up at six thirty. Seven fifteen é a hora em que saem de casa.

exercicios.q: I have ___ with my dad.
exercicios.exp: Nina toma café da manhã com o pai: breakfast.
exercicios.ouvir: I have breakfast with my dad.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I get up at half past six and I have a shower.
exercicios.exp: Shower: /XÁ-uer/, duas sílabas curtas.

exercicios.q: How does Nina go to school?
exercicios.exp: Do you go by bus? No, I go by train.

exercicios.resp: Nina does her homework after school
exercicios.exp: Com Nina (she) usamos does, não do.

exercicios.q: They leave home at ___.
exercicios.exp: We leave at seven fifteen (7.15). School starts later, at 8.45.
exercicios.ouvir: We leave home at seven fifteen.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: a que horas você acorda?
exercicios.frase: What time do you get up?
exercicios.modelo: I get up at seven o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Use I get up at... (horário).

exercicios.q: What does Nina do first after school?
exercicios.exp: I do my homework, then I play tennis: primeiro a lição de casa.

exercicios.q: Nina plays ___ after her homework.
exercicios.exp: Depois da lição, ela joga tênis: I play tennis.
exercicios.ouvir: She plays tennis after she does her homework.

aulas.objetivo: Entender um pedido em uma lanchonete: o que tem, o que não tem e o que cada um prefere.
aulas.foco: Food and drink; I'd like; some/any; like/don't like
explicacao: Para pedir: I'd like a sandwich, please. (I'd like = eu gostaria).
We haven't got any milkshakes = Não temos nenhum milk-shake. Any aparece em negativas e perguntas.
Gostos: I like chocolate. / I don't like strawberry.

falas.t: Hello. What would you like?
I'd like a cheese sandwich and an orange juice, please.
Sorry, we haven't got orange juice today. We've got apple juice and milk.
Then apple juice, please. And my brother would like some chips.
And a banana milkshake, please.
Sorry, no milkshakes. But we have got ice cream. Do you like strawberry?
No, I don't. I like chocolate.
OK. A cheese sandwich, an apple juice, chips and chocolate ice cream.

exercicios.q: What does the girl drink?
exercicios.exp: Não há suco de laranja; ela escolhe Then apple juice, please.

exercicios.q: I'd like a cheese ___, please.
exercicios.exp: Ela pede a cheese sandwich.
exercicios.ouvir: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I'd like a cheese sandwich and an apple juice, please.
exercicios.exp: I'd like: /aid laik/. Sandwich: /SÉN-uij/.

exercicios.q: Which ice cream does the boy NOT like?
exercicios.exp: Do you like strawberry? No, I don't.

exercicios.resp: We haven't got orange juice today
exercicios.exp: Haven't got = não temos.

exercicios.q: Sorry, we haven't got any ___.
exercicios.exp: O garçom diz: Sorry, no milkshakes.
exercicios.ouvir: Sorry, we haven't got any milkshakes.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: qual é a sua comida favorita?
exercicios.frase: What's your favourite food?
exercicios.exp: Use My favourite food is... ou I like...

exercicios.q: What does the waiter bring for the boy's dessert?
exercicios.exp: O garoto não quer morango: I like chocolate.

exercicios.q: The waiter brings a cheese sandwich, an apple juice, chips and ___ ice cream.
exercicios.exp: Pedido final: chocolate ice cream.
exercicios.ouvir: A cheese sandwich, an apple juice, chips and chocolate ice cream.

aulas.objetivo: Entender quem veste ou leva cada peça de roupa e de que cor ela é.
explicacao: Agora, neste momento: I'm wearing a blue jacket (present continuous).
Roupas no plural: jeans, trousers, socks, trainers. Contamos em pares: two pairs of socks.
A cor vem antes do nome: a red T-shirt, my green jumper.

falas.t: Emma, put your things in the bag. Have you got your blue jacket?
No, Mum. I'm wearing it. Look!
Oh, yes. And take your red T-shirt, two pairs of socks and your trainers.
My trainers are white, but they're dirty. Can I take my boots?
It's sunny this weekend. Take the trainers.
What about my yellow dress for the party?
A dress for a trip to the farm? No. Take your jeans and your green jumper.
OK. I like green!

exercicios.q: What colour is Emma's jacket?
exercicios.exp: Emma está vestindo a blue jacket. Red, yellow e green são outras peças.

exercicios.q: I'm ___ my blue jacket.
exercicios.exp: I'm wearing = estou vestindo.
exercicios.ouvir: I'm wearing my blue jacket.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Take your jeans and your green jumper.
exercicios.exp: Jumper: /JÂM-per/. Jeans: /djinz/.

exercicios.q: What does Emma NOT take?
exercicios.exp: A mãe diz No ao vestido amarelo (dress). Para a fazenda: jeans e jumper.

exercicios.resp: My trainers are white but they are dirty
exercicios.exp: Trainers é plural: are. They are = they're.

exercicios.q: Take two pairs of ___ and a red T-shirt.
exercicios.exp: Two pairs of socks (dois pares de meias).
exercicios.ouvir: Take two pairs of socks and a red T-shirt.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: o que você está vestindo hoje?
exercicios.frase: What are you wearing today?
exercicios.modelo: I'm wearing a blue T-shirt and black trousers.
exercicios.exp: Use I'm wearing + cor + roupa.

exercicios.q: Why does Mum say 'Take the trainers'?
exercicios.exp: Ela diz It's sunny this weekend (faz sol).

exercicios.q: Emma wants her yellow ___, but Mum says no.
exercicios.exp: Emma quer o vestido amarelo (yellow dress), mas a mãe diz não.
exercicios.ouvir: Emma wants to take her yellow dress, but Mum says no.

aulas.objetivo: Entender indicações de caminho e a posição de lugares na cidade.
aulas.foco: Places in town; prepositions of place; turn left/right; go straight on
explicacao: Direções: go straight on, turn left, turn right, at the traffic lights.
Posição: next to (ao lado), opposite (em frente), behind (atrás), in front of (na frente de), between (entre).
Lugares: library, post office, bookshop, supermarket, cinema, park.

falas.t: Excuse me, where's the library?
Go straight on, then turn left at the cinema. It's next to the post office.
Is the post office opposite the park?
No, the park is behind the library. The post office is opposite the bookshop.
Thank you. And is there a supermarket near here?
Yes, it's in Green Street. Turn right at the traffic lights and walk for five minutes.
Great. Is it open on Sundays?
Yes, until six o'clock.

exercicios.q: Where is the library?
exercicios.exp: It's next to the post office. O parque fica atrás da biblioteca.

exercicios.q: Turn ___ at the cinema.
exercicios.exp: Go straight on, then turn left at the cinema.
exercicios.ouvir: Turn left at the cinema.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Go straight on and turn left at the cinema.
exercicios.exp: Straight: /strêit/. Cinema: /SÍ-ne-ma/.

exercicios.q: Where is the park?
exercicios.exp: The park is behind the library. Opposite the bookshop está o correio.

exercicios.resp: Turn right at the traffic lights
exercicios.exp: Turn + direção + at + lugar.

exercicios.q: The supermarket is in ___ Street.
exercicios.exp: Yes, it's in Green Street.
exercicios.ouvir: The supermarket is in Green Street.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: tem um parque perto da sua casa?
exercicios.frase: Is there a park near your home?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, there is. It's next to my school.
exercicios.exp: Responda Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. e diga onde fica.

exercicios.q: What is opposite the bookshop?
exercicios.exp: The post office is opposite the bookshop.

exercicios.q: On Sundays the supermarket closes at ___ o'clock.
exercicios.exp: Yes, until six o'clock.
exercicios.ouvir: The supermarket is open until six o'clock on Sundays.

aulas.titulo: There is, there are: my home
aulas.objetivo: Entender a descrição de uma casa: cômodos, móveis e quantidades.
aulas.foco: There is / there are; rooms and furniture; some/any; numbers
explicacao: There is (There's) + singular: There's a balcony. There are + plural: There are three bedrooms.
Negativa: There isn't a garden. There aren't any posters.
Cômodos: bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living room, balcony, garden. Móveis: bed, desk, sofa, table, chair.

falas.t: Our new flat is great. There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
Is there a garden?
No, there isn't a garden, but there's a big balcony. There are lots of plants on it.
What's in your bedroom?
There's a bed, a desk and a small sofa. There aren't any posters yet.
Is there a TV?
Not in my room. There's a TV in the living room, and there are four chairs around the kitchen table.
Sounds lovely!

exercicios.q: How many bedrooms are there?
exercicios.exp: Three bedrooms. Two é o número de banheiros e four o de cadeiras.

exercicios.q: There is a big ___.
exercicios.exp: Não há jardim, mas há uma big balcony.
exercicios.ouvir: There is a big balcony.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: There are three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
exercicios.exp: Bedrooms: /BÉD-runs/. Bathrooms: /BÁTH-runs/.

exercicios.q: What is NOT in Leo's bedroom?
exercicios.exp: A TV está na sala (living room), não no quarto dele.
There aren't any + plural = não há nenhum.

exercicios.q: There are ___ chairs around the kitchen table.
exercicios.exp: Four chairs around the kitchen table.
exercicios.ouvir: There are four chairs around the kitchen table.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: o que tem no seu quarto?
exercicios.frase: What is in your bedroom?
exercicios.modelo: There is a bed and a desk.
exercicios.exp: Use There is a... / There are two...

exercicios.q: Where is the TV?
exercicios.exp: There's a TV in the living room.

exercicios.q: There isn't a garden, but there are lots of ___ on the balcony.
exercicios.exp: Na varanda há muitas plantas: lots of plants.
exercicios.ouvir: There isn't a garden, but there is a balcony with lots of plants.

aulas.objetivo: Entender o que cada pessoa está fazendo agora, numa conversa por telefone.
aulas.foco: Present continuous; present simple vs continuous; now
explicacao: Present continuous: am/is/are + verbo-ing. She is helping. They are playing.
Verbos que dobram a letra: sit → sitting, run → running. Verbos com e perdem o e: make → making.
Palavras de agora: now, at the moment. Use present simple para rotina e continuous para agora.

falas.t: Hello, Kim. What are you doing?
Hi, Dad. I'm at Grandpa's house. I'm helping him in the garden.
Is Grandpa working too?
No, he's sitting under the tree and he's reading a newspaper. Mum is cooking lunch in the kitchen.
And what's Tom doing?
He's playing with the dog. Oh, and it's raining now, so we're going inside.
OK. I'm coming at four o'clock.
Great, see you later!

exercicios.q: What is Kim doing?
exercicios.exp: Kim: I'm helping him in the garden. As outras ações são da mãe, do avô e do Tom.

exercicios.q: Grandpa is ___ under the tree.
exercicios.exp: Sit dobra o t: sitting.
exercicios.ouvir: Grandpa is sitting under the tree.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Mum is cooking lunch in the kitchen.
exercicios.exp: Cooking: /KÚ-quin/, com u curto.

exercicios.q: What is Grandpa doing?
exercicios.exp: Is Grandpa working too? No... he's reading a newspaper.

exercicios.resp: Tom is playing with the dog
exercicios.exp: Sujeito + is + verbo-ing + complemento.

exercicios.q: It's raining, so we are ___ inside.
exercicios.exp: Going inside = entrando.
exercicios.ouvir: It's raining, so we're going inside.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: o que você está fazendo agora?
exercicios.frase: What are you doing now?
exercicios.exp: Use I'm + verbo-ing.

exercicios.q: Why do they go inside?
exercicios.exp: Oh, and it's raining now, so we're going inside.

exercicios.q: Mum is cooking lunch while Tom is ___ with the dog.
exercicios.exp: Tom is playing with the dog.
exercicios.ouvir: Mum is cooking lunch while Tom is playing with the dog.

aulas.objetivo: Entender o que cada pessoa sabe ou não sabe fazer e escolher o grupo certo.
aulas.foco: can / can't; hobbies and sports; Can you...? Yes, I can.
explicacao: Can + verbo = saber/conseguir: I can swim. Não se usa to depois de can.
Negativa: can't (cannot). Pergunta: Can she sing? Yes, she can. / No, she can't.
Can não muda com he/she: she can play (nunca she cans).

falas.t: Welcome to the after-school club. What can you do, Max?
I can swim and I can ride a bike, but I can't play the guitar.
And you, Ella?
I can play the guitar and the piano. I can't swim very well.
Fantastic! Max, you can join the sports group on Mondays. Ella, you can join the music group on Thursdays.
Can my friend come too? She can sing really well.
Of course. Can she come on Thursday?
Yes, she can.

exercicios.q: What can Max do?
exercicios.exp: Max: I can swim and I can ride a bike. A guitarra e o piano são da Ella.

exercicios.q: I can ___ a bike.
exercicios.exp: Ride a bike = andar de bicicleta.
exercicios.ouvir: I can ride a bike.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I can play the guitar, but I can't swim very well.
exercicios.exp: Can't: /quént/ (britânico: /quant/). Can: fraco, /quen/.

exercicios.q: Which group can Ella join?
exercicios.exp: Ella toca instrumentos: music group on Thursdays. Max vai para o esporte, na segunda.

exercicios.resp: Can your friend come on Thursday
exercicios.exp: Pergunta com can: Can + sujeito + verbo.

exercicios.q: She can sing really well, but she ___ play the piano.
exercicios.exp: But indica contraste: depois de can, vem can't.
exercicios.ouvir: She can sing really well, but she can't play the piano.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: o que você faz bem?
exercicios.frase: What can you do well?
exercicios.modelo: I can swim and I can draw.
exercicios.exp: Use I can + verbo.

exercicios.q: What can Ella's friend do?
exercicios.exp: She can sing really well.

exercicios.q: Max can't play the ___.
exercicios.exp: Max: I can't play the guitar.
exercicios.ouvir: Max can swim, but he can't play the guitar.

aulas.objetivo: Entender preços, quantidades e troco numa conversa de compras.
aulas.foco: How much is/are...?; prices; plus, change; one pair/two pairs
explicacao: How much is...? para singular e How much are...? para plural: How much are the socks?
Preços: twelve pounds fifty (£12.50), three pounds (£3).
Altogether = no total. Change = troco.

falas.t: Good afternoon. Can I help you?
How much is this T-shirt?
It's twelve pounds fifty. And the blue one is fifteen pounds.
I'd like the blue one, please. And how much are the socks?
They're three pounds a pair.
Two pairs, please. How much is that altogether?
Fifteen plus six... that's twenty-one pounds.
Here's twenty-five pounds.
Four pounds change. Thank you!

exercicios.q: How much is the blue T-shirt?
exercicios.exp: The blue one is fifteen pounds. Twelve pounds fifty é a outra camiseta.

exercicios.q: The socks are ___ pounds a pair.
exercicios.exp: Socks: three pounds a pair.
exercicios.ouvir: The socks are three pounds a pair.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: How much are the socks?
exercicios.exp: Socks: /sócs/. Much: /mâtch/.

exercicios.q: How much does the girl pay altogether?
exercicios.exp: 15 + 6 = 21. Vinte e cinco foi o que ela entregou; quatro foi o troco.
Altogether fecha a pergunta.

exercicios.q: The girl gets ___ pounds change.
exercicios.exp: 25 - 21 = 4 pounds.
exercicios.ouvir: Here's twenty-five pounds. Four pounds change.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: quanto custa um sorvete na sua cidade?
exercicios.frase: How much is an ice cream in your town?
exercicios.exp: Use It's + número + moeda.

exercicios.q: What does the girl buy?
op: one T-shirt and two pairs of socks
two T-shirts and one pair of socks
one T-shirt and three pairs of socks
exercicios.exp: Ela compra a blue T-shirt e two pairs of socks.

exercicios.q: The cheaper T-shirt is twelve pounds ___.
exercicios.exp: It's twelve pounds fifty = £12.50.
exercicios.ouvir: It's twelve pounds fifty.

aulas.objetivo: Entender o que as pessoas fizeram no fim de semana, com verbos regulares e irregulares.
aulas.foco: Past simple (regular and irregular); did / didn't; last weekend
explicacao: Verbos regulares: + ed (visit → visited, play → played).
Irregulares comuns: go → went, eat → ate, take → took, swim → swam, have → had.
Pergunta e negativa usam did + verbo base: Did you go? No, I didn't go.

falas.t: Hi Joe! Did you have a good weekend?
Yes, I did. On Saturday I visited my grandparents. We played cards and I helped my grandpa in the garden.
Nice! Did you go to the cinema?
No, I didn't. I stayed at home on Sunday because it rained. I watched a film and I cooked pasta. And you?
I went to the beach with my cousins. We swam and we ate ice cream. Then we took a lot of photos.
Lucky you!

exercicios.q: What did Joe do on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: Saturday: I visited my grandparents. O filme foi no domingo e a praia é da Sara.

exercicios.q: We ___ cards on Saturday.
exercicios.exp: Passado de play: played.
exercicios.ouvir: We played cards on Saturday.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I went to the beach with my cousins.
exercicios.exp: Went: /uént/. Beach: /bitch/, i longo.

exercicios.q: Why did Joe stay at home on Sunday?
exercicios.exp: I stayed at home on Sunday because it rained.

exercicios.resp: Did you go to the cinema
exercicios.exp: Com did, o verbo fica no infinitivo: go (não went).

exercicios.q: Sara went to the beach and ___ ice cream.
exercicios.exp: Passado irregular de eat: ate.
exercicios.ouvir: Sara went to the beach and ate ice cream.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: o que você fez no fim de semana passado?
exercicios.frase: What did you do last weekend?
exercicios.modelo: I played football with my friends.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: I played, I went...

exercicios.q: What did Joe cook?
exercicios.exp: I watched a film and I cooked pasta.

exercicios.q: Joe ___ go to the cinema.
exercicios.exp: No, I didn't. Negativa do passado: didn't + verbo base.
exercicios.ouvir: Joe didn't go to the cinema. He stayed at home.

aulas.objetivo: Entender a descrição de uma pessoa ou animal: cor, tamanho, partes do corpo e idade.
aulas.foco: have got; adjectives; colours; describing; What does she look like?
explicacao: Para descrever: She is small. She has got long brown ears.
What does she look like? = Como ela é? Respondemos com adjetivos: small, big, long, short.
Ordem dos adjetivos: tamanho + cor + nome (a small brown dog).

falas.t: Happy Paws. Can I help you?
Yes, I've lost my dog. Her name's Coco.
What does she look like?
She's small and she's got long brown ears. She's brown and white, and she's got a red collar.
How old is she?
She's three. She was in the park near the school this morning.
OK. What's your name?
I'm Harry Wood, W-O-O-D.
Don't worry, Harry. We'll call you if we find her.

exercicios.q: What colour is Coco?
exercicios.exp: She's brown and white. As orelhas são brown.

exercicios.q: She's got long brown ___.
exercicios.exp: Long brown ears = orelhas compridas e marrons.
exercicios.ouvir: She's got long brown ears.

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: She is small and she has got a red collar.
exercicios.exp: Collar: /CÓ-la/. Small: /smol/.

exercicios.q: Where was Coco this morning?
exercicios.exp: In the park near the school: no parque, não na escola.
Look like pede descrição física.

exercicios.q: Coco is ___ years old.
exercicios.exp: She's three.
exercicios.ouvir: My dog is three years old.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: você tem um bichinho? Como ele é?
exercicios.frase: Have you got a pet? What is it like?
exercicios.modelo: I've got a cat. It's small and black.
exercicios.exp: Use I've got a... It's small/big and...

exercicios.q: What does Harry spell?
exercicios.exp: I'm Harry Wood, W-O-O-D: ele soletra o sobrenome.

exercicios.q: Coco is small, brown and white, and she's got a ___ collar.
exercicios.exp: A coleira é vermelha: a red collar.
exercicios.ouvir: She's brown and white and she's got a red collar.

aulas.objetivo: Fazer um simulado no estilo da prova: ligar pessoas a nomes, idades, horários e preços ouvidos.
aulas.foco: Mixed review: names, ages, clothes, activities, time, prices
explicacao: Na prova, ouça tudo uma vez primeiro e escreva só no fim de cada fala; o áudio toca duas vezes.
Cuidado com correções: a pessoa diz uma coisa e muda de ideia (twelve... no, thirteen!). A resposta é a última.
Escreva só a palavra ou o número ouvido. Se escrever, confira a ortografia.

falas.t: Kate, who are all the children in your party photo?
Well, the boy with the red cap is Sam. He's my cousin and he's eleven. The girl next to him is Lily. She's got a yellow dress and she's playing the guitar.
And who's the tall boy near the cake?
That's Fred. He's eating a sandwich. He's twelve, I think. No, wait, he's thirteen!
What about the girl with glasses?
That's Mia. She's drawing a picture of a horse. And the boy behind her is Dan. He's wearing a green jumper and he's taking photos.
When was the party?
Last Saturday. It started at three o'clock and finished at half past six.
How much was the cake?
Mum bought it at the shop for eighteen pounds. It was chocolate. Everybody loved it!

exercicios.q: Who is Sam?
exercicios.exp: The boy with the red cap is Sam. He's my cousin.

exercicios.q: What is Lily doing?
exercicios.exp: Lily has a yellow dress and she's playing the guitar. Os outros fazem as outras coisas.

exercicios.q: Fred is ___ years old.
exercicios.exp: Kate corrige: twelve, I think. No, wait, he's thirteen! Vale a última informação.
exercicios.ouvir: He's twelve, I think. No, wait, he's thirteen!

exercicios.q: Ouça se quiser e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Mia is drawing a picture of a horse.
exercicios.exp: Horse: /rrórs/. Picture: /PÍC-tcher/.

exercicios.q: Who is wearing a green jumper?
exercicios.exp: Dan is wearing a green jumper and taking photos.

exercicios.q: Mia is drawing a picture of a ___.
exercicios.exp: Mia is drawing a picture of a horse.
exercicios.ouvir: She's drawing a picture of a horse.

exercicios.q: What time did the party finish?
exercicios.exp: Half past six = 6.30. Three o'clock foi a hora em que começou.

exercicios.resp: The party started at three o'clock
exercicios.exp: Verbo no passado: started. At + hora.

exercicios.q: The cake cost ___ pounds.
exercicios.exp: Mum bought it for eighteen pounds. Cuidado: eighty seria 80.
exercicios.ouvir: Mum bought it at the shop for eighteen pounds.

exercicios.q: Responda em inglês: fale de uma festa a que você foi.
exercicios.frase: Tell me about a party you went to.
exercicios.modelo: I went to my friend's party last Saturday. We ate cake.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: I went, we ate, we played.

exercicios.q: What flavour was the cake?
exercicios.exp: It was chocolate. Everybody loved it!

exercicios.q: The boy with the red ___ is Sam, and he is eleven.
exercicios.exp: Sam is the boy with the red cap: cap = boné.
exercicios.ouvir: The boy with the red cap is Sam, and he is eleven years old.
